full_text:
ADDENDA <Presidential Decree No. 34789, Aug. 6, 2024>

Article 1 (Enforcement Date) This Decree enters into force on October 1, 2024.

Article 2 (Amendments to Other Statutes)
(1) The Regulations on Operational Units of Each Armed Service Whose Primary Mission Is Combat, etc. under Article 9 (3) of the Act on the Organization of the Armed Forces are partially amended as follows:

Subparagraph 4-4 is newly inserted in Article 3 as follows:

4-4. Strategic Command.

(2) The Enforcement Decree of the Act on Defense Reform is partially amended as follows:

Subparagraph 22 is newly inserted in Article 19 (1) as follows:

22. Commander of the Strategic Command.

(3) The Enforcement Decree of the Military Personnel Management Act is partially amended as follows:

In Article 13 (1) 2 (a), "President of the Korea National Defense University" is replaced with "President of the Korea National Defense University and Commander of the Strategic Command".

(4) The Organization of the Joint Chiefs of Staff is partially amended as follows:

In Article 3 (3), "Strategic Planning Headquarters, Military Support Headquarters, and Nuclear and Weapons of Mass Destruction Response Headquarters" is replaced with "Strategic Planning Headquarters and Military Support Headquarters".

Article 11-2 is deleted.
